description: Defines a reusable Flutter widget named EmptyState for displaying a simple placeholder with icon, title, optional subtitle, and optional action, used to represent an empty state in the UI.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays an icon, title, optional subtitle, and optional action button centered on the screen to indicate an empty state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget's visual representation, laying out the icon, texts, and optional action within a centered column.
